provenance.description: Original Darius curriculum build; not reconstructed from an official LEGO set.

coordinate_frame.name: robot_reference
coordinate_frame.calibration: identity reference only; not a calibrated hardware frame

observation.goal.meaning: known primitive target from the compiler, not a future measured state

action.meaning: one-frame Cartesian/yaw/gripper delta, not velocity, torque or a hardware command

split.generalization: same original assembly, held-out random scene translations and durations only

limitations: Synthetic kinematic references: neither robot demonstrations nor physics rollouts.
No RGB/depth, measured joint state, tactile signal, force measurement or physical success labels.
Cartesian goals require calibrated robot-frame transforms, IK and collision checks before hardware use.
Stud clutch, friction, insertion compliance and grasp stability are not simulated.
JSONL interchange format; convert and validate separately for LeRobotDataset v3.

training_draft.next_policy: ACT with measured joint states and synchronized wrist/overhead RGB demonstrations
training_draft.acceptance: held-out set-level physical insertion and full-build success; no claim from synthetic MSE
